description: DISTRICT 39 West Virginia’s House of Delegates now uses single-member districts, which means Mercer County is divided among multiple House districts instead of voting countywide for several delegates. Ronnie Oakley is running to represent House District 39, so this page is here to help residents better understand the district and where it fits within Mercer...
